## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Content update (question bank, exam templates, etc.)
- [ ] Infrastructure (build, CI, tooling, config)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run test:smoke`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual testing

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the project conventions (see AGENTS.md)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally
- [ ] Any runtime config changes are reflected in `config/runtime-auth.example.js` (not in the live file)
- [ ] I have checked for security implications (no secrets committed, CSP updated if needed)
